The standard-library checker independently verifies finite cases, with universal quantifiers established by proof.

value.rationale: The Euler form is the correction term in dimensions of equivariant Hilbert schemes and the quadratic energy of the generalized signed McKay graph. A natural full classification over every odd prime separates exactly two geometrically distinguished families whose formal Euler energy is nonnegative from all other weights, providing exact inertia for each. This is not a merely arbitrary numerical slice, because definiteness determines whether signed Euler corrections can be treated as a coercive energy modulo regular representations. No claim of geometric realizability of negative formal directions is made.
